key_rule: Separate coverage of the eight JRA race-local bet types from per-candidate purchase eligibility and buy/pass. WIN5 is explicitly out of scope for v3.4 at user request; neither forecast nor evaluation nor 9th row required.

decision_codes.buy: At least one independently purchase-eligible local candidate is adopted and frozen before post time.
decision_codes.no_value: Eligible local candidates exist but estimated reward/risk does not justify buying.
decision_codes.risk_high: Eligible local candidates exist but uncertainty, payout variability or race-specific risks justify pass.
decision_codes.insufficient_local_information: No independently qualified local purchase candidates exist. Cannot be used merely because some other ticket type or WIN5 is incomplete.

per_candidate_gate.quote_allow: Either verified official quote or dated named independent secondary quote with checked race, venue, date, ticket type and exact selection, and fetched before cutoff.
per_candidate_gate.quote_prohibit: Do not infer combined-ticket odds from win odds; do not treat unverified, stale or other-race odds as executable.
per_candidate_gate.probability_allow: Compute an explicit ordered finish probability for trifecta using coherent full-field pre-race win probabilities and an identified conditional ranking model. Record assumptions and sensitivity; uncalibrated estimates are only scenario-based and may inform, but never solely prove, a positive EV. For other tickets match exact finishing event and field size.
per_candidate_gate.probability_prohibit: Never fabricate certainty or exacta/trifecta hit rates from odds or rank alone; no naive independent product or unqualified point Plackett–Luce number as sufficient proof to buy. Lack of historical calibration lowers confidence but does not imply no numeric estimate can be calculated.
per_candidate_gate.high_ev_rule: A large point estimate alone does not trigger buy. Compare credible scenario range and downside. Document judgement and 1-ticket/100-yen baseline.

purchase_gate_fields.win5_status: Not present in v3.4. WIN5 is not predicted, evaluated, or counted as a coverage requirement.
purchase_gate_fields.candidates: Array of market candidates with candidate type/selection, quote evidence, probability uncertainty and eligibility decision
purchase_gate_fields.note: If local_coverage_status=partial and ≥1 candidate eligible, buy/pass is allowed but never claim global best across all eight types.

immutable_policy: Never mutate any historical v3.2/v3.3 STEP1, prediction, final_bets, proof_commit, reports, results, E2E comparison or local-racing data.
postrace_replay_policy: Never backdate post-start v3.4 as a prerace prediction or revise frozen v3.2/v3.3 decisions. v3.4 effective for future pre-race decisions only.
source_policy: JRA official preferred; dated source-matched secondary market quotes usable with source disclosure, not forced JRA cross-check if matching provenance adequate.
audit: Validate eight ordinary ticket types on v3.4+ via .github/scripts/validate-purchase-gate-v34.mjs and adapted nine-type legacy validator; do not touch historical v3.3 nine-type data. Verify explicit trifecta ordered probability inputs and sensitivity.
